16879-some-one-like-you.title: Some One Like You
16879-some-one-like-you.creator: Unknown
16879-some-one-like-you.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. How come the thoughts of you joyously welling  Up like the water of springs bubbling clear,  What a new joy everytime in the telling  Some thing that always I want you to hear. Roses of June or the snows of December  Gray be the skies or like azure the blue,  Far be the day that I may not remember,  Near to me, dear to me—Some one like you.

18742-willie-mouse.title: Willie Mouse
18742-willie-mouse.creator: Unknown
18742-willie-mouse.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Squirrel jumping from branch to branch. "Good afternoon," he said. "You do seem high up. Surely you can tell me the way to the moon. It's made of green cheese, you know." [Illustration] "I don't think it's made of green cheese; why shouldn't it be made of nuts?" "How ignorant everybody is," said Willie Mouse to himself. [Illustration] So on he went once more until he came to a little hole in the ground, and being very curious he peeped inside.

21681-a-little-traitor-to-the-south-a-wa.title: Tragic Interlude
21681-a-little-traitor-to-the-south-a-wa.creator: Cyrus Townsend Brady
21681-a-little-traitor-to-the-south-a-wa.description: A book by Cyrus Townsend Brady. Miss Fanny Glen's especial detestation was an assumption of authority on the part of the other sex. If there was a being on earth to whom she would not submit, it was to a masterful man; such a man as, if appearances were a criterion, Rhett Sempland at that moment assumed to be.

66737-priscilla-of-the-good-intent-a-rom.title: A Romance Of The Grey Fells
66737-priscilla-of-the-good-intent-a-rom.creator: Halliwell Sutcliffe
66737-priscilla-of-the-good-intent-a-rom.description: A book by Halliwell Sutcliffe. Billy drew nearer, with an anxious look. “Ye wouldn’t do that, or ye’d not be blacksmith David,” he said, with unerring knowledge of the other’s kindliness. ’Tis just a bit o’ sporting--I hadn’t thought of it i’ that light.”

arxiv-2104-10511.title: Hierarchical Convolutional Neural Network with Feature Preservation and Autotuned Thresholding for Crack Detection
arxiv-2104-10511.creator: QIUCHEN ZHU 1 , TRAN HIEP DINH 2,3 , MANH DUONG PHUNG 1,3, QUANG PHUC HA 1
arxiv-2104-10511.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by QIUCHEN ZHU 1 , TRAN HIEP DINH 2,3 , MANH DUONG PHUNG 1,3, QUANG PHUC HA 1. Drone imagery is increasingly used in automated inspection for infrastructure surface defects, especially in hazardous or unreachable environments. In machine vision, the key to crack detection rests with robust and accurate algorithms for image processing. To this end, this paper proposes a deep learning approach using hierarchical convolutional neural networks with feature preservation (HCNNFP) and an intercontrast iterative thresholding algorithm for image binarization.

arxiv-2108-01539.title: The energetics of quantum vacuum friction: Field fluctuations
arxiv-2108-01539.creator: Xin Guo ID, Kimball A. Milton ID, Gerard Kennedy ID, William P. McNulty ID, Nima Pourtolami ID, Yang Li ID
arxiv-2108-01539.description: Abstract Quantum fluctuations can induce a friction on a neutral but polarizable particle and cause it to radiate energy even if the particle is moving in free space filled with blackbody radiation, and is not in contact with or close to any surface or other object.

arxiv-2205-04776.title: Colorful Words and d d -Tverberg Complexes
arxiv-2205-04776.creator: Florian Frick, R. Amzi Jeffs
arxiv-2205-04776.description: Abstract We give a complete combinatorial characterization of weakly d d -Tverberg complexes. These complexes record which intersection combinatorics of convex hulls necessarily arise in any sufficiently large general position point set in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} . This strengthens the concept of d d -representable complexes, which describe intersection combinatorics that arise in at least one point set.

arxiv-2206-06562.title: Single production of vectorlike T T quark at future high-energy linear e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} collider
arxiv-2206-06562.creator: Lin Han 1 , Liu-Feng Du 2 , Yao-Bei Liu 2
arxiv-2206-06562.description: Abstract Based on a model-independent framework including the vectorlike top partner (VLQ- T T ), we investigate the prospect of discovering the singlet or doublet VLQ- T T via the single production process e − ​ e + → T ​ t ¯ + t ​ T ¯ e^{-}e^{+}\to T\bar{t}+t\bar{T} with the T → Z ​ t T\to Zt decay

arxiv-2206-07550.title: Evaluating and Inducing Personality in Pre-trained Language Models
arxiv-2206-07550.creator: Guangyuan Jiang jgy@stu.pku.edu.cn, Manjie Xu manjietsu@gmail.com, Song-Chun Zhu s.c.zhu@pku.edu.cn, Wenjuan Han wjhan@bjtu.edu.cn, Chi Zhang zhangchi@bigai.ai, Yixin Zhu yixin.zhu@pku.edu.cn
arxiv-2206-07550.description: Abstract Standardized and quantified evaluation of machine behaviors is a crux of understanding llm . In this study, we draw inspiration from psychometric studies by leveraging human personality theory as a tool for studying machine behaviors. Originating as a philosophical quest for human behaviors, the study of personality delves into how individuals differ in thinking, feeling, and behaving.

arxiv-2210-05478.title: Aggregating Layers for Deepfake Detection
arxiv-2210-05478.creator: Amir Jevnisek, Shai Avidan
arxiv-2210-05478.description: Abstract The increasing popularity of facial manipulation (Deepfakes) and synthetic face creation raises the need to develop robust forgery detection solutions. Crucially, most work in this domain assume that the Deepfakes in the test set come from the same Deepfake algorithms that were used for training the network. This is not how things work in practice.

arxiv-2409-15660.title: An Effective Slope Gap Distribution for Lattice Surfaces
arxiv-2409-15660.creator: Tariq Osman, Josh Southerland, Jane Wang
arxiv-2409-15660.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tariq Osman, Josh Southerland, Jane Wang. We prove an effective slope gap distribution result first for the square torus and then for general lattice translation surfaces. As a corollary, we obtain a dynamical proof for an effective gap distribution result for the Farey fractions.

arxiv-2411-08153.title: Leidenfrost drop dynamics: An approach to follow the complete evolution
arxiv-2411-08153.creator: René Ledesma-Alonso, Benjamin Lalanne, Jesús Israel Morán-Cortés, Martín Aguilar-González, Felipe Pacheco-Vázquez
arxiv-2411-08153.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by René Ledesma-Alonso, Benjamin Lalanne, Jesús Israel Morán-Cortés, Martín Aguilar-González, Felipe Pacheco-Vázquez. A new model to follow the complete evolution of a drop in Leidenfrost state is presented in this work. The main ingredients of the phenomenon were considered, including: 1) the shape and weight of a sessile drop, according to its size, compared to the capillary length, using the Young-Laplace equation; 2) the evaporation at the entire surface of the drop, due to the heat transfer across the vapor film, to the proximitiy of

arxiv-2501-10716.title: Radiative properties of thin accretion disks around rotating short-hairy black holes
arxiv-2501-10716.creator: Shou-Qi Liu, Jia-Hui Huang
arxiv-2501-10716.description: Abstract The radiative properties of the accretion disks around rotating short-hairy black holes are studied. The geodesic motion of massive particles in the equatorial planes of short-hairy black holes and impact of the rotation parameter a a , short-hair parameter Q Q and power parameter k k on the geodesic motion is obtained.

arxiv-2505-13898.title: Do Language Models Use Their Depth Efficiently?
arxiv-2505-13898.creator: Róbert Csordás, Christopher D. Manning, Christopher Potts, {manning, cgpotts}@stanford.edu
arxiv-2505-13898.description: Abstract Modern LLMs are increasingly deep, and depth correlates with performance, albeit with diminishing returns. However, do these models use their depth efficiently ? Do they compose more features to create higher-order computations that are impossible in shallow models, or do they merely spread the same kinds of computation out over more layers?

arxiv-2511-06693.title: Force-Free Electromagnetic Configurations in Arbitrary Geometries radhikari@troy.edu
arxiv-2511-06693.creator: Rakshak Adhikari
arxiv-2511-06693.description: Abstract The dynamics of highly magnetized plasmas in extreme astrophysical environments are effectively modeled by Force-Free Electrodynamics (FFE), a framework essential for studying objects like neutron stars and accreting black holes. The inherently nonlinear nature of the FFE equations makes finding exact solutions a challenging task.

arxiv-2511-10953.title: Language-Guided Graph Representation Learning for Video Summarization Thanks: Wenrui Li, Wei Han, Hengyu Man, Wangmeng Zuo and Xiaopeng Fan are with the Department of Computer Science and Technology, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin 150001, China, and also with Harbin Institute of Technology S
arxiv-2511-10953.creator: Wenrui Li, Wei Han, Hengyu Man, Wangmeng Zuo
arxiv-2511-10953.description: Abstract With the rapid growth of video content on social media, video summarization has become a crucial task in multimedia processing. However, existing methods face challenges in capturing global dependencies in video content and accommodating multimodal user customization. Moreover, temporal proximity between video frames does not always correspond to semantic proximity.

arxiv-2511-15679.title: Front-door Reducibility: Reducing ADMGs to the Standard Front-door Setting via a Graphical Criterion
arxiv-2511-15679.creator: Jianqiao Mao, Max A. Little
arxiv-2511-15679.description: Abstract Front-door adjustment gives a simple closed-form identification formula under the classical front-door criterion, but its applicability is often viewed as narrow. By contrast, the general ID algorithm can identify many more causal effects in arbitrary graphs, yet typically outputs algebraically complex expressions that are hard to estimate and interpret.

arxiv-2512-19625.title: Counterexamples for FX Options Interpolations - Part II
arxiv-2512-19625.creator: Jherek Healy
arxiv-2512-19625.description: Abstract This follow-up article analyzes the impact of foreign exchange option interpolation on the vanilla option implied volatilities. In particular different exact interpolations of broker quotes may lead to different implied volatilities at the 10 Δ \Delta and 25 Δ \Delta Puts and Calls.

arxiv-2602-05329.title: SynAT : Enhancing Security Knowledge Bases via Automatic Synthesizing Attack Tree from Crowd Discussions DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Journal: TOSEM
arxiv-2602-05329.creator: Ziyou Jiang, Lin Shi, Guowei Yang, Xuyan Ma, Fenglong Li, Qing Wang
arxiv-2602-05329.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Ziyou Jiang, Lin Shi, Guowei Yang, Xuyan Ma, Fenglong Li, Qing Wang. Cyber attacks have become a serious threat to the security of software systems. Many organizations have built their security knowledge bases to safeguard against attacks and vulnerabilities. However, due to the time lag in the official release of security information, these security knowledge bases may not be well maintained, and using them to protect software systems against emergent security risks can be challenging.

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-new-year-s-da.title: New Year's Day (Catholic Encyclopedia article)
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-new-year-s-da.creator: John Tierney
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-new-year-s-da.description: Article 'New Year's Day' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

europmc-pmc5753159.creator: Bongomin F, Gago S, Oladele RO, Denning DW.
europmc-pmc5753159.description: Fungal diseases kill more than 1.5 million and affect over a billion people. However, they are still a neglected topic by public health authorities even though most deaths from fungal diseases are avoidable. Serious fungal infections occur as a consequence of other health...

plos-pone-0007055.creator: Ming D. Li, Jamie E. Mangold, Chamindi Seneviratne et al.
plos-pone-0007055.description: PLOS ONE research article. Previous studies have demonstrated that the γ-aminobutyric acid type B (GABA B ) receptor plays an essential role in modulating neurotransmitter release and regulating the activity of ion channels and adenyl cyclase. However, whether the naturally occurring polymorphisms in the t

pmc-10503104.title: Association between adiposity and facial aging: results from a Mendelian randomization study
pmc-10503104.creator: Meiqi Liu, Jingwei Feng
pmc-10503104.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundSkin, as a sociologically meaningful interface, has psychological implications different from other organs, particularly in the context of the global population aging. Growing evidence suggests that facial aging is associated with an increased risk of adiposity.

pmc-10656129.title: Assessment of Vulvar Intraepithelial Neoplasia (VIN) Grades Based on Dermoscopic Features: A Diagnostic Study
pmc-10656129.creator: Vincenzo De Giorgi, Elisabetta Magnaterra, Biancamaria Zuccaro, Manfredi Magliulo, Vincenza Maio, Angela Muccilli, Federico Venturi, Ignazio Stanganelli, Daniela Massi
pmc-10656129.description: IntroductionVulvar intraepithelial neoplasia (VIN) is a vulvar skin lesion considered a precursor of vulvar squamous cell carcinoma. No characteristics have been discovered to date that allows us to differentiate between grades of VIN, such as correlating the thickness of involvement of the epithelium (VIN1, VIN2, and VIN3) to the dermoscopic pattern.

pmc-10671197.title: School-Based Nutrition Programs in the Eastern Mediterranean Region: A Systematic Review
pmc-10671197.creator: Ayoub Al-Jawaldeh, Dana Matbouli, Sarah Diab, Mandy Taktouk, Leila Hojeij, Sally Naalbandian, Lara Nasreddine, Andrew Gray, Arpita Basu
pmc-10671197.description: This systematic review aims at documenting government-led school nutrition programs/interventions in countries of the Eastern Mediterranean Region (EMR). A systematic review of the available literature on this topic was conducted between 25 October 2022 and 15 November 2022 using 15 electronic databases as well as grey literature.

pmc-11335685.title: Trematocine-derived antimicrobial peptides from the Antarctic fish Trematomus bernacchaii: potent antibacterial agents against ESKAPE pathogens
pmc-11335685.creator: Damiano Squitieri, Federica Massaro, Monica Mollica Graziano, Stefano Borocci, Margherita Cacaci, Maura Di Vito, Fernando Porcelli, Roberto Rosato, Francesca Ceccacci, Maurizio Sanguinetti, Francesco Buonocore, Francesca Bugli
pmc-11335685.description: IntroductionThis study investigated the interaction with membrane mimetic systems (LUVs), bacterial membranes, the CD spectra, and the bactericidal activity of two designed trematocine mutants, named Trem-HK and Trem-HSK. Mutants were constructed from the scaffold of Trematocine (Trem), a natural 22-amino acid AMP from the Antarctic fish Trematomus bernacchii, aiming to increase their positive charge.

pmc-11656133.title: A Dual‐Purpose Non‐Canonical Amino Acid for the Expanded Genetic Code: Combining Metal‐Binding and Click Chemistry
pmc-11656133.creator: Graham J Day, Andrey V Zaytsev, Richard C Brewster, Valery N Kozhevnikov, Amanda G Jarvis
pmc-11656133.description: A rationally designed dual‐purpose non‐canonical amino acid (Trz) has been synthesised and successfully incorporated into a protein scaffold by genetic code expansion. Trz contains a 5‐pyridyl‐1,2,4‐triazine system, which allows for inverse‐electron‐demand Diels–Alder (IEDDA) reactions to occur on the triazine ring and for metal ions to be chelated both before and after the click reaction.

pmc-12542369.title: Invasion prediction with artificial intelligence in ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS) patients: a proof-of-concept study
pmc-12542369.creator: Adnan Gundogdu, Ceyda Sonmez Wetherilt, Ayhan Alpar, Sangar Abdullah, Osman Cem Yilmaz, Levent Celik
pmc-12542369.description: BackgroundDuctal carcinoma in situ (DCIS) is a heterogeneous precursor lesion with variable invasive potential. Current predictive parameters for invasion risk offer limited utility for personalized assessment. This study aims to evaluate artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted mammography analysis as a tool for predicting invasion risk in DCIS patients.

pmc-12686698.title: A Scoping Review of Large Language Models in Personal Sleep Wellness
pmc-12686698.creator: Hamid Mansoor
pmc-12686698.description: As sleep health becomes increasingly central to personal well-being, individuals are turning to digital tools for education, tracking, and behavior change support. Large language models like ChatGPT and Gemini have recently emerged as promising components of these tools, capable of generating personalized, conversational, and context-aware sleep guidance.

pmc-12714122.title: Natural Aging of a Local Indonesian Rice Variety: Physical, Chemical, and Cooking Quality Analyses
pmc-12714122.creator: Purwa Tri Cahyana, Titi Candra Sunarti, Erliza Noor, Hartrisari Hardjomidjojo, Noer Laily, Adadi Parise
pmc-12714122.description: Rice (Oryza sativa) of the Ciherang variety has been widely stored in warehouses for years as government food reserves. Storing rice for a long time causes a decrease in quality due to the natural aging process. This study is aimed at revealing the quality parameters most affected by the natural aging of rice during long‐term storage (12–48 months).

pmc-12737558.title: Evaluation of a Cell-Adapted Live Attenuated African Swine Fever Virus Thai-Strain Vaccine Candidate: Highlighting Enhanced Virulence Risk in Co-Infected Pigs
pmc-12737558.creator: Challika Kaewborisuth, Theeradej Thaweerattanasinp, Nanchaya Wanasen, Apidsada Chorpunkul, Payuda Hansoongnern, Nathiphat Tanwattana, Kanjana Srisutthisamphan, Janya Saenboonrueng, Asawin Wanitchang, Suphot Wattanaphansak, Rachod Tantilertcharoen, Nattachai Suksawat, Jarin Kramyu, Benjamas Liwnaree,
pmc-12737558.description: Background/Objectives: African swine fever (ASF) is a devastating disease affecting the swine industry globally. Development of safe and effective vaccines is an urgent need. This study aimed to evaluate, caASFV001-MA52, a cell-adapted ASFV strain derived from serial passaging in MA-104 cells, as a promising live-attenuated vaccine (LAV) candidate against virulent ASFV infection.

pmc-12967342.title: Insights on accelerometer-measured 24-hour movement behaviour across type 2 diabetes sub-phenotypes in the Asian population
pmc-12967342.creator: Huili Zheng, Keven Ang, Natarajan Padmapriya, Tsz Kiu Kwan, Mei Chung Moh, Serena Low, Falk Mueller-Riemenschneider, Su Chi Lim
pmc-12967342.description: IntroductionPreviously, we observed that subgroups of type 2 diabetes (T2D) – mild obesity-related diabetes (MOD), mild age-related diabetes (MARD), severe insulin-resistant diabetes (SIRD) – had distinct characteristics and complications. This study aims to investigate if movement behaviour also differs by T2D subgroup.

pmc-13145761.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A500 ASSOCIATIONS OF COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY ANGIOGRAPHY-BASED PLAQUE-RADS SUBTYPES WITH SYMPTOMATIC CAROTID ATHEROSCLEROSIS
pmc-13145761.creator: Louise Maes, Jo P P Peluso, Jelle Demeestere, Anke Wouters, Philippe Desfontaines, Adinda De Pauw, Rónán Collins, Dominick J H McCabe, Simon Cronin, David Williams, Sylvie De Raedt, Francisco Purroy, Geert Vanhooren, George Pope, Peter Vanacker, Tim Cassidy, Cathal Walsh, Daniel Bos, Peter Kelly, Ro
pmc-13145761.description: Background and aimsCarotid Plaque-RADS (Plaque Reporting and Data System) scoring offers a reproducible framework to characterize internal carotid artery (ICA) plaque morphology across imaging modalities. This study investigated associations between Computed Tomography Angiography (CTA)-based Plaque-RADS subgroups and recurrent vascular events in patients with non-cardioembolic stroke/TIA.

pmc-13258999.title: Correction: Pattadakal et al. Poly(vinyl alcohol) Nanocomposites Reinforced with CuO Nanoparticles Extracted by Ocimum sanctum: Evaluation of Wound-Healing Applications. Polymers 2025, 17, 400
pmc-13258999.creator: Shrishail Pattadakal, Vanita Ghatti, Sharanappa Chapi, Vidya G., Yogesh Kumar Kumarswamy, M. S. Raghu, Vidyavathi G. T., Nagaraj Nandihalli, Deepak R. Kasai

pmc-13415730.title: Oncolytic virus OHSV2 induces pyroptosis in bladder cancer cells via the TLR4/NLRP3/Caspase-1/GSDMD pathway
pmc-13415730.creator: Jinzhou Xu, Yifan Xiong, Chenqian Liu, Jianxuan Sun, Ye An, Zhiyu Xia, Binlei Liu, Jia Hu, Qidong Xia, Shaogang Wang
pmc-13415730.description: Bladder cancer remains a significant clinical challenge due to high recurrence and progression rates, necessitating novel therapeutic strategies. Oncolytic viruses, such as the herpes simplex virus type 2-based OHSV2, have demonstrated promising antitumor effects through direct oncolysis and immune activation. This study investigated the efficacy, safety, and molecular mechanisms of OHSV2 in the treatment of bladder cancer.

uslaw-usc-t10-s7073.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part I (Organization); Chapter 707 (The Army). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) There are chaplains in the Army. The Chaplains include— (1) the Chief of Chaplains; (2) commissioned officers of the Regular Army appointed as chaplains; and (3) other officers of the Army appointed as chaplains in the Army.
